---
title: Requesting a Project, Access Control
---

Kubernetes clusters support two types of projects:
- Individual projects
- Group projects

When you sign into the [Rancher instance](https://rancher.cloud.e-infra.cz), you receive a default individual project (see [here](./rancher) for more information) with the default quotas described [here](./quotas).

You must be a valid MetaCentrum member to access projects in Rancher. If you are not a member, register [here](https://metavo.metacentrum.cz/en/application/index.html).

## Requesting a Group Project
We are preparing a convenient request form that will be available on this page when ready. In the meantime, contact us at k8s@cerit-sc.cz if you need a group project. By default, group projects receive 12 CPU *request*, 64 CPU *limit*, 40GB RAM *request*, and 256GB RAM *limit*. 

### Using an Existing Group for Access Control
If you already have a group in **perun.e-infra.cz**, include the group's VO in your email. If the group is in the VO e-infra.cz, also include the group's ID.

Provide the following information:
- Name of the new project
- Desired resource quota (optional if the default is sufficient)
- The person responsible for the project (name, organization, and either UCO if from MU or MetaCentrum login)

<Callout type="warn">**Access control = assigning the group** remains your responsibility as the requester, following the [tutorial below](#access-control)</Callout>

### No Group Yet for Access Control
If you don't have a group, we will create one for you. Include the note "create a new group for a Rancher project" in your email.

Provide the following information:
- Name of the new project
- Desired resource quota (optional if the default is sufficient)
- The person responsible for the project (name, organization, and either UCO if from MU or MetaCentrum login)


## Access Control
Provide the name of the person responsible for project access control. You (or someone from your group) manage who can access the project. Even if you know an existing Perun group name you'd like to use, you must assign it yourself. After we prepare the Perun resource, the responsible person receives administrator privileges. Administrators can add other administrators, assign allowed groups to the resource, or add members.

The most common access control method involves assigning a group with multiple members to a Perun resource. The following tutorial shows **an administrator** (the person you designated in your email) how to assign such a group.

1. Log into [CESNET Perun](https://perun.aai.cesnet.cz).
2. Scroll down the home page until you see the `Manager in Resources` table.
![manager](/img/ceritsc/request-project-images/manager.png)
3. Click the resource matching your requested project name.
4. Click `Assigned Groups`.
![manager](/img/ceritsc/request-project-images/assign_button.png)
5. Click `Assign Groups`, enter the group name in the search bar, and select the desired group.
![manager](/img/ceritsc/request-project-images/assign_group.png)
6. Click `Next`, leave all options as they are, and click `Assign group`.
7. Changes take 5-10 minutes to propagate. Wait at least 10 minutes, then log out and back into Rancher or simply refresh the page. You and all group members should now see the project.

<Callout type="warn">Remember: the administrator must also be a group member to access the project/service</Callout>

## Requesting a Larger Individual Project
We are preparing a convenient request form that will be available on this page when ready. In the meantime, contact us at k8s@cerit-sc.cz if you need a larger project for your personal use.

In your email, include:

- Desired resource quota
